name: Lau ba khia
summary: Lẩu ba khía lá buôi is a mangrove-crab hotpot. Dân Việt says ba khía is also made into mắm, and that the pot has a fatty, clean-sweet crab riêu. In Cần Giờ the leaf is lá buôi, also called rau bộ đội, nutty, and better the more thoroughly you cook it. The story ties the leaf to meals of the Rừng Sác special forces, then to ordinary home cooking.
howToEat: Share the pot after a day on the creeks. Dip lá buôi until it is fully cooked.
